title: Add support for metadata in text scenes
body:
- Supersedes #82532

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

* Closes #76366
* Adds support for metadata in text scenes, they already worked with binary scenes before.
* Old scenes without metadata works fine.
* `[resource]` tag does not get added unless the scene have a metadata, there will be no change to old scenes.

## Additional information
* Text Scenes can now have `resource_name`s and among other things
* More things for sure are now possible because I had to go trough hoops to be able to add `PackedScenes` as metadata.
  * Embedded metadata scenes are just saved as resources with the addition that they can have a node list
* All of the above already worked before with the scene as binary, but not as text.
* As a side effect, nested scene files are easier to read.

An example of how the scene is saved with metadata, including resources metadata, and even scenes:
```ini
[gd_scene format=3]

[sub_resource type="Resource" id="Resource_ntalc"]
resource_name = "I'm a child resource"

[sub_resource type="PackedScene" id="PackedScene_etj3x"]
resource_name = "Hello world"
metadata/other_resource = SubResource("Resource_ntalc")
metadata/ExampleMetadata = Vector2i(40, 80)
metadata/string = "The
string
with
unnecessary
line
	\\
breaks"
[node name="inner_named_node" type="Node3D" unique_id=1340554638]

[sub_resource type="Resource" id="Resource_llbx0"]
resource_name = "I'm a child resource"

[resource]
resource_name = "Hello world"
metadata/other_resource = SubResource("Resource_llbx0")
metadata/ExampleMetadata = Vector2i(40, 80)
metadata/string = "The
string
with
unnecessary
line
	\\
breaks"
metadata/inner_scene = SubResource("PackedScene_etj3x")

[node name="named_node" type="Node3D" unique_id=2090576258]
```

Unit tests were added to make things slightly easier.

### What this PR DOES NOT solve:
This PR only solves differences between what you can do with text or binary scene files. So the following problems will require future PRs (probably extending from this PR):
* If you save the metadata, open the scene in the editor and save it, the metadata is lost. The same happens with the scene binary file. (PR with fix: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/123163)
* ~~You cannot edit metadata of scenes in the editor.~~ You can edit scene metadata in editor, you could for a while already, including custom scenes, you just couldn't save with `.tscn`, only with binary files without this PR,[ here's a video of me doing it in 4.7.1](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/122231#issuecomment-5535698130).
* Classes that inherit PackedScene does not have type information in the file. So the loader fails to load them.
   The PR that aims to fix this is: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/122180
